pedal: Boss RT-2 Rotary Ensemble (mono in: INPUT A; stereo out: OUTPUT A and B), each rotor alone, clean
comment: The follow-up's isolated-rotor takes again: there the ring moved with the Drive Knob toggle on DRIVE at the second take, so Mode II's 'horn alone' was both rotors and every later take ran at Drive 5:00. Same signals and speed (white noise at -12 dB, Slow 9:00, LED green). Each take is checked as it lands: the both-rotor ones against session 1's (Drive 7:00, Balance 12:00, within 1.5 dB per octave), a rotor alone by the other rotor's octave (30 dB down; the drum alone the same on both outputs). Clock positions: 7:00 = fully counter-clockwise, 5:00 = fully clockwise.

takes.name: bypass-noise
takes.note: Effect off. Same cables: OUTPUT A -> input 2, OUTPUT B -> input 1.

takes.name: m1-both-noise

expect.hint: Drive and Balance aren't where the plan says (Drive 7:00, Balance 12:00). Set the ring again: toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00; toggle to BALANCE, ring to 12:00; then r.

takes.note: Effect on, LED green (hold the RT-2's own pedal if it's red), Slow (outer ring of knob 2) to 9:00. Set the outer ring of knob 1 twice: Drive Knob toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00 (no Drive); then toggle to BALANCE, ring to 12:00. Leave the toggle on BALANCE for the whole run: from here on the ring sets Balance only. Give the rotors ~10 s.

expect.hint: the drum is still in it, so Balance isn't at 5:00 (with the toggle on DRIVE the ring sets Drive). Set the ring again: toggle to DRIVE, ring to 7:00; toggle to BALANCE, ring to 5:00; then r.

takes.note: Ring to 5:00 (the toggle stays on BALANCE): the horn alone.
